profile.name: Sandee Srisawat
profile.headline: Building the systems behind the play.
profile.intro: I’m a game programmer interested in creating responsive gameplay, thoughtful systems, and memorable player experiences.
profile.about: I’m interested in the details that make a game feel good to play: responsive controls, thoughtful interactions, and systems that work together.
profile.approach: This space is for my story: how I approach a difficult problem, what I enjoy building, and what draws me to game programming. I’ll add that story alongside my work.
